defeat.text: And THAT'S how we did it on Death Watch. Somebody get me a drink.
Stay down, sweetheart. Uncle Kreese has a bar tab waiting.
Ah, I needed that. Better than a hot shower and a cold beer.
I've had hangovers that put up a better fight than you.
Somebody sweep that up. I'm not touching it.
Woo! Still got it. Never lost it. Never even misplaced it.
That's one more for the wall. I'm gonna need a bigger wall.
Tell the devil Kreese says hi. He owes me twenty bucks.

knockdown.text: Floor's comfy, huh? Stay a while.
Get up! I ain't done with you.
Did that hurt? It looked like it hurt.
That's a Kreely special. Free of charge.
And she drops like my third marriage!

hurt.text: Ow! Son of a... that's coming outta your hide.
That all you got? ...Don't answer that.
Hit me again. I dare ya. Actually, don't.
Ugh! I felt that one in my liver. What's left of it.
Damn it, that was my good side!

near_death.text: Oh, that ain't good... I'm leaking.
I'm seeing two of you. Neither one of you is pretty.
Howard was right. I should've stretched.
Okay, time out. Time out! ...Nobody's calling time out.
If I die out here, my liquor cabinet goes to nobody. NOBODY!
I've been worse. I can't remember when, but I've been worse.
Ain't the first time I've been almost dead. Won't be the last.

teeth.text: My teef! Thoze were my good teef!
Aw, come on! I just paid those off!
Thas... thas gonna cost ya, lady.
Well, there goes dinner. Soup it is.
Keep 'em. Something to remember me by.
